method: text/policy review of every proposed error against the canonical page_lines text, LABELLING-POLICY.md, TRANSCRIPTION-STATE.md and policy.json; no images inspected, no canonical edit, no transcript correction invented

verdict_rules.accept: verbatim canonical text plus local context establishes a specific pupil error and the expected correction without an unavailable teacher source
verdict_rules.undecided: a scope or ink question the visible text cannot settle (heading line, layout-likely artifact, composite whose single correction is not uniquely fixed)
verdict_rules.reject: not an established pupil error: normal wraps/joins, table or heading artifacts, abbreviations, note-taking punctuation conventions (dash spacing, list markers, entry-final periods, leading line-break commas), factual slips, no-op/synthetic proposals, or duplicates
verdict_rules.deferred_mapping: deferred = (error_class == 'meaning'), per LABELLING-POLICY.md section 1, which defers agreement, case, duplicated words, missing hyphens between a digit and a word, and sentence-level wrongness and tags them meaning; letters, punctuation and capitalization stay in current scope
verdict_rules.composites: kept as one record when the proposed error is one defect with components
verdict_rules.verified: every ACCEPT is text-decisive only; verified_from_pixels is false throughout

line_join_check.rule: each proposal's 'written' string must occur verbatim in the cited canonical line, or in the join of that line with its neighbour (trailing carry hyphen removed)

coverage_observations: P33-E02 accepts the digit+word hyphen at p33-l04 ('2 место') but the same line carries the identical agreement defect as P33-E03 ('США занимает'); the line-4 agreement is not proposed.

P35-E01 and P35-E02 describe the same garbled rule sentence (p35-l26/27); they are kept as two records because they are different tokens on different lines, but the proposal's expected for P35-E02 overlaps P35-E01's wording.
residual_limits: No pixel inspection: items whose only evidence is transcription notation (dash spacing, list markers, entry-final periods, line-start commas) are REJECTED or deferred rather than confirmed.

ACCEPT records rest on the canonical transcript's own attributions (uncertain[] 'the pupil's own ...') and on deterministic orthography/grammar; Astra must confirm them at the pixels before publication.
Page 34 has no proposal error (13 existing Astra labels retained); it is out of this review.
The proposal's page-policy totals are unchanged by this review: 64 proposed, 43 accepted, 3 undecided, 18 rejected.
